summary.text: Spiraling Dragon Fang is Duke Long's immortal killer move. Solid snow-white dragon fangs leave his mouth, grow into curved blades, and spiral to cut and pin a target.

claims.text: Fighting Purple Mountain True Monarch, Duke Long opens his mouth so two teeth fall out and swell in the wind into snow-white dragon fangs shaped like curved blades. He then activates the immortal killer move spiraling dragon fang; the two fangs shoot out faster than Purple Mountain True Monarch can match and spiral around him, striking with dazzling sharp light. Purple Mountain True Monarch notes that the fangs are solid, unlike ordinary ephemeral killer-move constructs, and that their power forces him to answer the move.

Even after Duke Long falls into a dream realm, the two white fang lights keep spiraling onto Purple Mountain True Monarch, miss for a time, then keep circling for another opening without needing Duke Long’s ongoing manipulation.

Against Seven Extreme Desolation, Duke Long treats the offensive move as defense: the dragon fangs cut any immortal binding rope that tries to hold him. Bing Sai Chuan recalls the original fangs as only arm-sized, yet under Duke Long’s then-boosted state they stand like two gigantic pillars.

Later he spatters a hundred sharp teeth that expand into a swarm of snow-white fang blades, shredding Calamity Luck Altar and heavily damaging Seven Extreme Desolation; new teeth grow in his mouth and fly out again to shroud both foes. Bing Sai Chuan’s injuries through the damaged altar are framed as the result of those spiraling dragon fangs.
